name: Copeland Furniture Factory Outlet
old_description: Copeland Furniture has been designing and manufacturing natural hardwood furniture for over 50 years, using hardwoods sustainably harvested in the Northeast. We create durable furniture with timeless designs that will last for generations. Visit our Factory Outlet located in Bradford, Vermont to explore our furniture in person.
about:
Copeland Furniture Factory Outlet operates in Bradford, Vermont, as the direct retail arm of a company that has designed and manufactured natural hardwood furniture for more than five decades. The business uses hardwoods sustainably harvested in the Northeast, though the exact founding year and ownership structure are not disclosed in public materials.

The outlet showcases the manufacturer's full range of bedroom, dining, living room, and home office collections, all produced from those regional hardwoods. In addition to first-quality pieces, the store stocks factory seconds—items with minor cosmetic flaws—at substantial discounts, with new seconds arriving weekly. The outlet also carries a line of Italian-made mattresses to complement its bed and storage-bed offerings.

The location serves customers across Northern New England and in other regions not covered by the company's independent dealer network. A dedicated Designer Program is available for qualified interior designers, providing trade access to the collections.

The company emphasizes clean design, fine quality, and value, positioning its furniture as durable pieces intended to last generations. The factory-outlet model allows buyers to inspect solid-wood construction in person and take advantage of seconds pricing without waiting for dealer shipments.
